verdict.rationale: SavvyCal offers a documented REST API (JSON, OAuth/PAT auth), a JavaScript embed library, and webhooks, and a probe confirms a live machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec at api.savvycal.com/v1/spec — giving AI-native developers a concrete, machine-readable contract to build against. However, there is no evidence of dedicated official SDK packages (e.g., published Python, Node, Ruby client libraries) beyond the embed script, and llms.txt/openapi.json discovery paths return 404s. Missing for 10: official language SDK packages, first-party client libraries beyond the embed widget, and a documented/llms.txt-style AI discovery surface.
